HomePage.introduction-text: I design and build modern web applications with a focus on performance, clean architecture, and clear, intuitive UX/UI. I emphasize code quality and solutions designed for long-term growth.
HomePage.introduction-sub-text: I have experience from both personal projects and commercial application development, where I contributed to solution design, technical decisions, and code quality.

ProjectsPage.project-jmk-desc1: Development of an external portal capable of displaying data from other modules within the DERS ecosystem.
ProjectsPage.project-jmk-desc2: A custom-built web application designed based on specific client requirements, with the goal of creating a transparent and intuitive tool for presenting subsidy data in a user-friendly interface. The solution focused not only on application architecture but also on secure integration with internal systems.
ProjectsPage.project-jmk-desc3: The project included designing and exposing a secure API from an internal module and integrating it with the external application. A key challenge was ensuring secure data processing and presentation with a strong emphasis on data integrity and protection, as well as aligning internal DERS systems with the public-facing layer. Performance optimization was also crucial, especially when working with large datasets.
ProjectsPage.project-jmk-desc4: The result is a modern, secure, and scalable portal that efficiently retrieves data from internal modules and presents it in a clear and logical structure. The application enables easy management, regular updates, and future extensibility while fully meeting client requirements for functionality, security, and user experience.
ProjectsPage.project-eoc-desc1: It all started with a vision, moved through design concepts, and ended with a successful implementation.
ProjectsPage.project-eoc-desc2: The goal of the redesign was to breathe new life into the e-commerce part of an enterprise module and transform it into a modern, competitive system with a strong focus on intuitive and enjoyable user experience across all devices.
ProjectsPage.project-eoc-desc3: The main challenge was to maintain full compatibility with existing data structures while introducing new UX elements without disrupting the existing logic and system functionality.
ProjectsPage.project-eoc-desc4: The result is a cleaner, more structured, and user-friendly e-shop that appeals to a wide range of users—both those who prefer familiar workflows and those who expect a modern and dynamic experience.
ProjectsPage.project-d4l-desc1: A modern, responsive website for the Drive4Life driving school, featuring a fresh and distinctive design.
ProjectsPage.project-d4l-desc2: Built with modern technologies and integrated with the external system Moje Autoškola, the website offers users a simple and intuitive way to enroll in courses or access detailed information about individual training programs.
ProjectsPage.project-d4l-desc3: Strong emphasis was placed on a clear content structure, easy navigation, and a seamless registration process. The user interface is designed for maximum clarity and minimal steps required to complete enrollment.
ProjectsPage.project-d4l-desc4: The entire solution is designed with scalability and future extensibility in mind, allowing for easy addition of new features or adjustments based on client needs.
ProjectsPage.project-hrs-desc1: From logo design to the development of a one-page website with a custom administration system, the entire solution was created as a cohesive product with a focus on functionality, easy management, and consistent visual identity.
ProjectsPage.project-hrs-desc2: The project included the design and development of a presentation website with a custom administration system built on PHP and SQL. The solution involved creating a custom template structure, simple routing, and an admin layer for managing content, services, and user reviews.
ProjectsPage.project-hrs-desc3: The application was designed with an emphasis on simplicity, direct data management, and independence from external CMS platforms. It uses a custom database model, MySQL integration, and a clear separation between presentation and application logic, making it easy to modify and extend.
ProjectsPage.project-hrs-desc4: The result is a functional one-page website with its own backend infrastructure, enabling efficient content management, dynamic data handling, and a tailored administrative environment.
